IRS990.MissionDesc: The primary objectives and purposes of this corporation shall be to promote major gift fundraising for Point Loma Nazarene University through excellence in strategic development, major donor engagement, and oversight of Foundation assets.
IRS990.Desc: Funds raised by the PLNU Foundation are primarily used to support Point Loma Nazarene University in the form of student financial aid.

Form990ScheduleAPartVIGrp.ExplanationTxt: The organization is a Type 1 supporting organization and is not required to complete the public support schedule. Schedule A, Part II is completed to verify that the Foundation can qualify under public charity status section 170(b)(1)(A)(vi) and qualified to use the first listed special rule for Schedule B reporting.

SupplementalInformationDetail.FormAndLineReferenceDesc: Schedule D, Part V, Line 4 Intended uses of endowment funds
SupplementalInformationDetail.ExplanationTxt: Provide scholarship funds and support the general operations of the Foundation and University.

SupplementalInformationDetail.FormAndLineReferenceDesc: Schedule I, Part I, Line 2 Procedures for monitoring use of grant funds.
SupplementalInformationDetail.ExplanationTxt: Organizational grants are funds transferred to the supported organization for operational support. These funds are monitored under common management. Tuition assistance to individuals is paid directly to Point Loma Nazarene University on behalf of the recipient student. Amounts are applied directly to student accounts, and no cash changes hands.

The Foundation has no employees. Compensation amounts on Form 990 Part VII are from a related organization. Therefore, these questions related to approval of officer compensation are not applicable to the Foundation and are answered "no" in accordance with the instructions

SupplementalInformationDetail.FormAndLineReferenceDesc: Form 990, Part VI, Line 7a Members or stockholders electing members of governing body
SupplementalInformationDetail.ExplanationTxt: The Foundation's board members are subject to election by the Point Loma Nazarene University Board of Trustees.

SupplementalInformationDetail.FormAndLineReferenceDesc: Form 990, Part VI, Line 7b Decisions requiring approval by members or stockholders
SupplementalInformationDetail.ExplanationTxt: Amendment of the Foundation's bylaws is subject to approval by a majority of the Board of Trustees of Point Loma Nazarene University (PLNU). In addition, the Foundation may only be dissolved upon the direction of the Board of Trustees of PLNU.

SupplementalInformationDetail.FormAndLineReferenceDesc: Form 990, Part VI, Line 11b Review of form 990 by governing body
SupplementalInformationDetail.ExplanationTxt: The Form 990 is prepared by an independent CPA firm, reviewed in detail by the finance department, and then distributed to the Board of Directors for review before being filed with the IRS.

SupplementalInformationDetail.FormAndLineReferenceDesc: Form 990, Part VI, Line 12c Conflict of interest policy
SupplementalInformationDetail.ExplanationTxt: Conflict of interest statements are completed annually by all members of the Board of Directors. The Chair of Point Loma Nazarene University's Audit Committee reviews the statements. The finance team also monitors all transactions for potential conflicts of interest. Should any potential conflicts of interest be disclosed, the board member or officer would be asked to refrain from participation in any deliberation or decision with regard to matters affected by the relationship.

SupplementalInformationDetail.FormAndLineReferenceDesc: Form 990, Part VI, Line 19 Required documents available to the public
SupplementalInformationDetail.ExplanationTxt: The Foundation's governing documents, conflict of interest policy, and financial statements are available upon request.

Employees of Point Loma Nazarene University, a related organization, perform some administrative functions for the Foundation. The amounts reported on Form 990, Part IX, Lines 5 through 10 represent the portion of the employees' compensation related to the services provided to the Foundation. Point Loma Nazarene University files all payroll information returns as required by the IRS and the Foundation reimburses the University for the employees' time spent on Foundation matters.
